notes.test_set: Every metric here was computed by this analysis from a checkpoint the training run selected on val/f1_macro. No test metric influenced any checkpoint, epoch or row choice, and the test/* columns written into each training run's metrics.csv were not read.
notes.a6_vs_p: A6 follows the specification and uses diffusion_i5_k15; row P is the shipped model and uses diffusion_i5_k15, which is what Step 6 selected. They are different configurations and A6 is not the proposed model.
notes.a8: A8's classification metrics are A7's by construction. Its contribution is qualitative - deletion/insertion and MC-dropout uncertainty from Step 19.
notes.row_p_seeds: Row P is reported from Step 16, which evaluated one checkpoint by design. Its across-seed spread is therefore not comparable with a three-seed A-row's; treat the P comparison as single-seed.
notes.imbalance_settings: Every A-row pins augment=false and use_weighted_sampler=false, matching the observed Step 8 'baseline' selection. If a full-profile Step 8 selects otherwise, the rows do NOT follow it - the conflict is reported rather than silently applied.
